title: Hannah’s Prayer and Eli’s Sons

questions.question: What is the theme of Hannah's prayer?
options: God's sovereignty and raising the poor
questions.correctAnswer: God's sovereignty and raising the poor
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:1-10 (ESV): Describes God extending power, breaking the mighty, and raising the poor from the dust.

questions.question: Who were Eli’s wicked sons?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:12, 34 (ESV): The sons of Eli were worthless men... Hophni and Phinehas.

questions.question: What sin did Eli’s sons commit?
options: Taking meat from offerings before it was burned
questions.correctAnswer: Taking meat from offerings before it was burned
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:15-17 (ESV): “...the priest’s servant would come and say... ‘Give meat for the priest to roast...’ Thus the sin of the young men was very great...”

questions.question: Who prophesied doom to Eli’s house?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:27 (ESV): “And there came a man of God to Eli and said to him, ‘Thus says the Lord...’”

questions.question: What did Hannah bring Samuel each year?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:19 (ESV): “And his mother used to make for him a little robe and take it to him each year...”

questions.question: How many more children did Hannah have?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:21 (ESV): "And the LORD visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters..."

questions.question: Why did Eli rebuke his sons?
options: For he heard of their evil dealings with all the people
questions.correctAnswer: For he heard of their evil dealings with all the people
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:23 (ESV): "He said to them, 'Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.'"

questions.question: Why did Eli's sons not listen to their father?
options: Because it was the will of the Lord to put them to death
questions.correctAnswer: Because it was the will of the Lord to put them to death
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:25 (ESV): "...But they would not listen to the voice of their father, for it was the will of the LORD to put them to death."

questions.question: What sign was given to Eli regarding the end of his house?
options: Both his sons, Hophni and Phinehas, would die on the same day
questions.correctAnswer: Both his sons, Hophni and Phinehas, would die on the same day
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:34 (ESV): "And this that shall come upon your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, shall be the sign to you: both of them shall die on the same day."

questions.question: What does the Lord do to those who honor Him?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:30 (ESV): "...for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me shall be lightly esteemed."

questions.question: Hannah prayed, "My heart ____ in the Lord".
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:1 (ESV): "And Hannah prayed and said, 'My heart exults in the LORD...'"

questions.question: What did the man of God say would happen to the survivors of Eli's house?
options: They would come and bow down for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread
questions.correctAnswer: They would come and bow down for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:36 (ESV): "...shall come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread..."

questions.question: Where did the women serve whom Eli's sons lay with?
options: At the entrance to the tent of meeting
questions.correctAnswer: At the entrance to the tent of meeting
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:22 (ESV): "...and how they lay with the women who were serving at the entrance to the tent of meeting."

questions.question: The man of God reminded Eli that God revealed Himself to his father's house where?
options: In Egypt, when they were subject to the house of Pharaoh
questions.correctAnswer: In Egypt, when they were subject to the house of Pharaoh
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:27 (ESV): "...Did I indeed reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt subject to the house of Pharaoh?"

questions.question: What description is given of Samuel's growth?
options: He continued to grow both in stature and in favor with the Lord and also with man
questions.correctAnswer: He continued to grow both in stature and in favor with the Lord and also with man
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 2:26 (ESV): "Now the boy Samuel continued to grow both in stature and in favor with the LORD and also with man."

key_verse_text: ...for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me shall be lightly esteemed. (ESV)
